article.title: Why More Customers Does Not Always Mean More Growth
article.why: Practical analytical English for data-driven decisions.

paragraphs.en: A business may report that it has more customers than last year. That sounds like growth, but the customer count alone does not tell the full story. First, the observation window may have changed. If this year’s dataset covers twelve months but last year’s covers only nine, more people have a chance to appear. Second, customer IDs may change. One person can look like two customers after replacing a card, creating a new account, or moving to another system. Unless IDs are linked correctly, the count can rise without any real acquisition. Activity level also matters. A company may add many people who buy only once and never return. The total customer count grows, but active customers, repeat purchases, revenue, or profit may not improve. The opposite can also happen: a smaller group of loyal customers may create more value than a larger group of one-time buyers. Analysts should therefore define what customer means. Is it anyone with one transaction, a member with a valid account, or someone active during the last twelve months? They should also separate new customers from reactivated customers and existing customers using a new channel. A useful growth report combines customer count with retention, purchase frequency, revenue, margin, and acquisition quality. More customers can be good news, but the count needs context. Growth means more than adding rows to a customer table. Analysts should document the population, observation window, assumptions, and operational definition before drawing a conclusion. A useful review separates the observed metric from the mechanism that may have produced it and from the action that should follow. This discipline makes the result easier to reproduce, challenge, and communicate to stakeholders. paragraphs.zh: 繁中完整翻譯與解說：本文的核心不是只看表面指標，而是先確認母體、分母、時間範圍與選擇機制，再判斷數字是否真的代表 business outcome 改善。分析時要區分觀察事實、可能機制與因果結論，並把不確定性、經濟價值與下一步 action 一起納入。
paragraphs.ja: 日本語完全訳・解説：表面的なmetricだけで結論を出さず、母集団、分母、期間、selection mechanismを確認したうえでbusiness outcomeの改善を判断する。観察事実、考えられるmechanism、因果的な結論を分け、不確実性、経済価値、次のactionまで含めて説明することが重要である。
